symptom: PC1 cannot reach Server1 in VLAN 30; gateway ping works
topology_note: PC1 in VLAN 10, Server1 in VLAN 30, router-on-a-stick
show_outputs:
GigabitEthernet0/0.10 is up, line protocol is up
GigabitEthernet0/0.30 is administratively down, line protocol is down
expected_fault: Sub-interface for VLAN 30 is administratively down

symptom: PC2 gets no IP address, shows APIPA 169.254.x.x
topology_note: PC2 connected to Switch1, DHCP server is Router1
show_outputs:
ip dhcp pool VLAN20
 network 192.168.20.0 255.255.255.0
! (no default-router configured)
expected_fault: DHCP pool missing default-router statement

symptom: PC3 can ping gateway but not external website by name, IP ping works
topology_note: PC3 in VLAN 10, DNS server 8.8.8.8 configured on router
show_outputs:
ip dhcp pool VLAN10
 dns-server 0.0.0.0
 default-router 192.168.10.1
expected_fault: DNS server set to invalid address 0.0.0.0 in DHCP pool

symptom: Two hosts on same VLAN cannot reach each other, ARP fails
topology_note: PC4 and PC5 both in VLAN 10
expected_fault: Duplicate IP address 192.168.10.10 assigned to two hosts

symptom: Remote branch cannot reach HQ subnet, ping times out
topology_note: Static route configured on Router2 toward HQ
expected_fault: Wrong subnet mask in static route (should be /24 not /32)

symptom: PC6 can reach gateway but nothing beyond it
topology_note: PC6 gateway configured manually
expected_fault: Gateway mismatch — gateway IP is in a different subnet than the host

symptom: Trunk link between switches not passing VLAN traffic
topology_note: Switch1 and Switch2 connected via trunk
show_outputs:
interface GigabitEthernet0/1
 switchport mode access
 switchport access vlan 10
expected_fault: Trunk port configured as access port instead of trunk

symptom: New VLAN 40 hosts cannot reach anything, even each other
topology_note: VLAN 40 created on switch but not on router sub-interface
show_outputs:
show vlan brief
40 VLAN0040 active Gi0/2
expected_fault: Missing router sub-interface / SVI for VLAN 40

symptom: Internal server unreachable from outside network despite NAT config
topology_note: Router configured with static NAT for web server
show_outputs:
ip nat inside source static 192.168.1.10 203.0.113.5
! interface Gi0/0 missing 'ip nat outside'
expected_fault: Outside interface missing 'ip nat outside' command

symptom: Host can ping internal servers but not internet
topology_note: PAT (overload) configured for internet access
show_outputs:
ip nat inside source list 1 interface Gi0/0
! access-list 1 not defined
expected_fault: Missing overload — referenced access-list 1 does not exist

symptom: Admin PC blocked from Telnet to router despite correct credentials
topology_note: ACL applied to VTY lines
show_outputs:
access-list 10 deny 192.168.10.20
line vty 0 4
 access-class 10 in
expected_fault: ACL explicitly denies the admin PC's IP on VTY access-class

symptom: Guest Wi-Fi users can reach internal file server
topology_note: Guest VLAN should be isolated from internal VLAN
show_outputs:
access-list 101 permit ip any any
! no deny rule for guest-to-internal traffic
expected_fault: ACL missing deny rule for guest VLAN reaching internal VLAN (isolation failure)

symptom: OSPF neighbors not forming between Router1 and Router2
topology_note: Both routers configured for OSPF area 0
show_outputs:
Router1: network 10.0.0.0 0.0.0.255 area 0
Router2: network 10.0.0.0 0.0.0.255 area 1
expected_fault: Area ID mismatch between OSPF neighbors (area 0 vs area 1)

symptom: Wireless clients connect but get no internet
topology_note: WLC configured with DHCP relay to Router1
show_outputs:
interface Vlan50
 ip helper-address 192.168.99.99
expected_fault: ip helper-address points to wrong/non-existent DHCP server IP

symptom: Wireless SSID visible but clients cannot authenticate
topology_note: WPA2-PSK configured on access point
show_outputs:
AP config: authentication key-management wpa version 2
! passphrase not set
expected_fault: WPA2 passphrase/PSK not configured on the access point

symptom: Router reload lost all interface configs
topology_note: Configs were made in running-config only
show_outputs:
show run | include boot
! no 'copy run start' history found
expected_fault: Running-config was never saved to startup-config before reload

symptom: PC17 cannot get IP, DHCP requests time out
topology_note: DHCP server on separate VLAN from client, no relay configured
show_outputs:
interface Vlan10
 ip address 192.168.10.1 255.255.255.0
! no ip helper-address
expected_fault: Missing ip helper-address on client VLAN interface to reach remote DHCP server

symptom: Static route to branch office not appearing in routing table
topology_note: Static route configured but next hop unreachable
show_outputs:
ip route 172.16.0.0 255.255.0.0 10.0.0.99
! 10.0.0.99 not directly connected
expected_fault: Next-hop IP for static route is not reachable/directly connected

symptom: Switch port keeps going into err-disabled state
topology_note: Port-security configured with max 1 MAC address
show_outputs:
interface Fa0/5
 switchport port-security maximum 1
 switchport port-security violation shutdown
%PORT_SECURITY-2-PSECURE_VIOLATION
expected_fault: Port-security violation — more than 1 MAC address seen on the port

symptom: VLAN 30 hosts intermittently lose connectivity, STP topology changes logged
topology_note: Redundant switch links without STP tuning
show_outputs:
%SPANTREE-2-ROOTGUARD_BLOCK
show spanning-tree vlan 30
! frequent topology change notifications
expected_fault: Spanning-tree instability / possible switching loop causing topology changes

symptom: PC21 has correct IP/gateway but cannot resolve internal hostnames
topology_note: Internal DNS server configured on Router1
show_outputs:
ip dhcp pool VLAN10
 dns-server 192.168.50.5
! 192.168.50.5 is not the actual DNS server IP (should be 192.168.10.5)
expected_fault: Wrong DNS server IP configured in DHCP pool

symptom: Inter-VLAN routing works for VLAN 10-20 but not VLAN 10-30
topology_note: Router-on-a-stick with three sub-interfaces
show_outputs:
interface Gi0/0.30
 encapsulation dot1Q 30
 ip address 192.168.30.1 255.255.255.0
! missing 'no shutdown' history on physical Gi0/0
expected_fault: Physical parent interface Gi0/0 administratively down, disabling all sub-interfaces

symptom: Site-to-site VPN tunnel not establishing between two routers
topology_note: IPSec VPN configured with pre-shared keys
show_outputs:
Router1: crypto isakmp key CISCO123 address 203.0.113.2
Router2: crypto isakmp key CISCO321 address 203.0.113.1
expected_fault: Pre-shared key mismatch between VPN peers

symptom: EtherChannel between two switches not bundling, ports show independent
topology_note: Port-channel configured with mismatched modes
show_outputs:
Switch1: channel-group 1 mode active
Switch2: channel-group 1 mode on
expected_fault: EtherChannel negotiation mode mismatch (LACP active vs static on)

symptom: Host in VLAN 10 can ping 192.168.10.1 but not 192.168.10.254 (both claim to be gateway)
topology_note: HSRP configured between two routers for redundancy
show_outputs:
Router1: standby 1 ip 192.168.10.1
Router2: standby 1 ip 192.168.10.254
expected_fault: HSRP virtual IP mismatch between the two routers in the same group

symptom: PC26 shows 'destination host unreachable' when pinging server on same subnet
topology_note: PC26 and server on VLAN 10, connected via same switch
show_outputs:
PC26: 192.168.10.20 255.255.255.0
Switch: interface Fa0/6 is down, line protocol is down
expected_fault: Physical switch interface for PC26 is down (cable/port issue)

symptom: ACL blocks legitimate HTTP traffic to web server after recent change
topology_note: Extended ACL applied inbound on Gi0/0
show_outputs:
access-list 105 deny tcp any any eq 80
access-list 105 permit ip any any
expected_fault: Deny rule for port 80 placed before the general permit — order of ACL entries matters

symptom: Router does not forward traffic between two directly connected subnets
topology_note: Router has two interfaces, ip routing appears disabled
show_outputs:
show run | include ip routing
! no ip routing (line absent)
expected_fault: Global 'ip routing' command not enabled on the router

symptom: PC29 cannot reach any device, even same-subnet gateway
topology_note: Recently reconfigured with a new subnet mask
expected_fault: Subnet mask too restrictive, gateway falls outside PC29's calculated subnet range

symptom: Voice VLAN phones register but have poor call quality, no QoS applied
topology_note: Voice VLAN configured on access ports but no QoS policy
show_outputs:
interface Fa0/10
 switchport voice vlan 50
! no service-policy configured
expected_fault: No QoS/traffic prioritization policy applied for voice VLAN traffic

symptom: Newly added host in VLAN 20 gets IP but cannot reach VLAN 20 server 2 hops away
topology_note: Multi-router topology with EIGRP
show_outputs:
Router2: show ip eigrp neighbors
! neighbor table empty, no adjacency formed
expected_fault: EIGRP autonomous system number mismatch preventing neighbor adjacency

symptom: Backup default route not taking over when primary ISP link fails
topology_note: Two static default routes configured, one should be floating backup
expected_fault: Backup route missing administrative distance value, so it competes with primary instead of floating
